blocks.title: LIMITED PRODUCT WARRANTY
paragraphs: Within 10 years from the date of installation, Jackery guarantees that the solar roof system it supplies, under the condition that it is installed, used, and maintained in accordance with the installation manual, will not experience product component failures caused by material or process defects that affect the normal installation or use of the product. (Except as otherwise specified in other clauses)

blocks.title: LIMITED POWER WARRANTY
paragraphs: Jackery offers a 25-year power output warranty starting from the date of installation, with the following terms:
Years 1–10: Actual power output shall not be less than 90% of the nameplate rating
Years 11–25: Actual power output shall not be less than 80% of the nameplate rating
Power output must be measured only under Standard Test Conditions (STC: Air Mass 1.5, Irradiance 1000W/m², Module Temperature 25°C).
All measurements must be performed by a third-party measurement institution approved either by the supplier or mutually by both parties.
In accordance with IEC 60904, test uncertainty must be taken into account in all output measurements.

blocks.title: AFTER-SALES WARRANTY
paragraphs: If the product does not work properly within the warranty period, you can contact our customer service team at hello@jackery.com for after-sales service. You will need to provide a valid proof of purchase, proof of warranty, product serial number, photographic or video proof of failure, and other information required by our customer support team for after-sales service.

Jackery will be responsible for the repair or replacement (at Jackery’s expense) of any Jackery product that fails to operate during the applicable warranty period due to defective workmanship or materials. The repaired or replaced product will carry the remaining warranty period of the original purchase date.
